title: Shinrei Tantei Yakumo Initial File Novels' Manga Adaptation Resumes

title: Unseen Studio's Kemuri Game Streams 1st Gameplay Trailer
content: Game director Ikumi Nakamura 's Unseen game studio unveiled the first gameplay trailer for its Kemuri game during Sony 's "Stage of Play" livestream on Tuesday. The game features solo or up 3-person co-op play where players take on the role of Yokai Hunters.
author: ANN

title: 'Can I take your photo?' Manga Moves Serialization to Young King Magazine on June 22
content: AI localization company Orange Inc. 's emaqi e-bookstore service publishes the manga in English, and describes the story: A high school girl struggling with self-confidence discovers photography, connecting with the world through her camera lens.
author: ANN

title: Nyankees' Atsushi Okada Launches Tataki the Side Hustle Manga
content: Manga creator Atsushi Okada launched a new manga titled Tataki the Side Hustle in Shogakukan 's Manga ONE service on May 30. The manga centers on three young men working at a laundry service store in a run-down commercial district.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man Reveals Its True Ending, And It’s Perfect
content: Chainsaw Man Part 2 came to an end earlier this year, surprisingly without confirming whether a third part of the manga would follow. It has now been confirmed that there won’t be another part, as the manga’s final volume, scheduled for release on June 4, includes new pages that put an even firmer stop to the series.
author: ComicBook

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Game Announces September 25 Release, Playable Demo
content: CAPCOM revealed during Sony 's "State of Play" livestream on Tuesday its Onimusha: Way of the Sword game will launch for PlayStation 5 on September 25. The company also revealed a playable demo is available now.

title: Fire Emblem Engage Manga Heads Towards Climax
content: Kazurō Kyō announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday that the Fire Emblem Engage manga adaptation of Nintendo 's strategy RPG will reach its climax soon. Kyō launched the manga in Shueisha 's Saikyō Jump magazine and on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ website and app in May 2023.
author: ANN

title: Major Shonen Jump Creator to Return With New 2026 Series After 6 Years
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump is set to introduce a new wave of series through the rest of the month, and this includes a major creator returning to the magazine six years after their last full series came to an end.
